controls.label: Head size (%)
controls.help: Head proportions relative to the authored body. Face details resize together.

controls.label: Shoulder width (%)
controls.help: Shoulder spacing relative to the authored body. Arms and clothing follow.

controls.label: Hip width (%)
controls.help: Hip spacing relative to the authored body. Legs and clothing follow.

controls.label: Chest depth (%)
controls.help: Chest depth relative to the authored body. 100% is the original shape.

controls.label: Arm length (%)
controls.help: Arm proportions relative to the authored body. Hands and held equipment follow the resized rig.

controls.label: Torso length (%)
controls.help: Torso proportions relative to the authored body. The rig and upper body move together.

controls.label: Leg length (%)
controls.help: Leg proportions relative to the authored body. 100% is the original shape.

controls.label: Height (m)
controls.help: Standing height in metres. Proportion changes keep this overall height.

controls.label: Blade length (m)
controls.help: Blade length (m). The attachment frame stays connected.

controls.label: Blade width (m)
controls.help: Blade width (m). The attachment frame stays connected.

controls.label: Guard width (m)
controls.help: Guard width (m). The attachment frame stays connected.

controls.label: Blade thickness (m)
controls.help: Thickness of the blade. The grip and guard stay in place.

controls.label: Handle length (m)
controls.help: Resize the handle and move its grip frame together. The equipped sword stays in the hand.

controls.label: Width (m)
controls.help: Overall shield width. The painted face and rear grip resize together.

controls.label: Curve depth (m)
controls.help: Curvature of the convex front and concave back. The grip remains behind the shell.
